kind: regression gate after a night of edits, plus two findings that were not about the product

findingOne.what: the mirror still had no 0.1.10 metadata about 1.8 hours after publish
findingOne.why: the bundled pnpm resolves against registry.npmmirror.com, so installing the exact version failed with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION even though registry.npmjs.org served it
findingOne.action: re-triggered the sync endpoint; within 30 seconds the mirror listed 0.1.10
findingOne.lesson: the sync request at publish time is a request, not a guarantee; a re-trigger is cheap and effective, and a publish is not 'installable everywhere' until the mirror says so
findingOne.thirdTimeSamePit: this is the third time in one night that a test setup installed an exact version the mirror did not yet know

findingTwo.what: scripts/e2e-browser.mjs waited for the literal string 'Review Outbox 0.1.0' in the preview
findingTwo.why: the demo fixture is supplied by the caller (DSH_REVIEW_OUTBOX_DEMO_DIR), so a fixture using any other version fails a hardcoded assertion
findingTwo.fix: the assertion now matches any semantic version, and the reason is written in the script
findingTwo.note: the script had encoded one historical fixture's content; the release it was written for is months of fixtures ago in this project's terms
